# utility.maxwell_boltzmann { #clerq.utility.maxwell_boltzmann }

```python
utility.maxwell_boltzmann(v, fwhm, offset=0.0)
```

Maxwell-Boltzmann probability distribution.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                     | Default    |
|--------|------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| v      | np.ndarray | velocity (or detuning) values.                  | _required_ |
| fwhm   | float      | full-width at half-maximum of the distribution. | _required_ |
| offset | float      | centre of the distribution (default 0).         | `0.0`      |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                 |
|--------|------------|---------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | Probability density at each value in ``v``. |
